author: Youkun
quote: The GTA franchise built its fame on freedom, edgy humor, and satirizing serious situations.While GTA 6 has great graphics and solid gameplay, it completely lacks the freedom and edge that made the series famous. Forcing players to do chores and housework is baffling. On top of that, the writing is a huge letdown. Jason’s reaction to finding out Lucia hid his own kid from him makes no sense he was practically happy about it, despite her having multiple chances to let them talk on the phone and choosing not to. There are also several scenes where Jason watches other guys hit on her, including a naked man named Mario dancing right in front of her. It comes across like pure cuckoldry. Games like GTA 5 and San Andreas used to mock couples like Jason and Lucia, yet here they are as the main focus. Overall, it’s baffling and extremely disappointing.
